rv.q: Maybe it’s because, after well over a year, this was (to my knowledge) the first live production in the Chicago area. Maybe it’s the fact that this entertaining pop musical revue features so many wonderful hit songs that spark youthful memories for the majority of the audience.
If you love live theater, this is a reminder of how stage performances can deliver a thrill, even from the other side of a parking lot.
The stunning singing voices, gorgeously mixed music, and period costumes provide us with an extensive trip down memory lane. What a special treat to hear nearly sixty hit songs!
It is a must-see for anyone in the Chicagoland area looking for a talent-filled fun event.

cn.t: Critics praise this energetic jukebox revue featuring nearly 60 beloved hits, highlighting the talented cast's stellar vocals and nostalgia-inducing performances that made it a hot summer ticket.
